concerns.text: FR-003 requires a chi‑squared goodness‑of‑fit test **against the uniform distribution**. Task T006 implements `code/stats.py` that computes chi‑squared **against biased expected counts** derived from literature, which does not satisfy the specification.

FR-005 mandates visualization artifacts that overlay observed frequencies with the **uniform expectation** (N/p). Task T010’s visualization suite explicitly plots the **theoretically biased baseline** instead of the uniform line, violating the requirement.

The spec’s Edge Cases section requires (a) rejection of unsupported primes with a clear error message, and (b) logging of sieve overflow failures. No task in `tasks.md` addresses these edge‑case behaviours, leaving the requirement uncovered.

Task T006’s description states: “Statistical engine conforming to schema – … computes the χ² statistic against the **biased** expected counts derived from the literature.” This contradicts FR-003 and FR-005 which demand testing and visualizing against a uniform baseline.
Task T010’s description: “Visualization suite … overlays the theoretically biased baseline …” conflicts with the uniform‑expectation requirement of FR-005.
